name: Conditional NeRF with Sinusoidal Positional Encoding
definition: A conditional NeRF formulation that maps position, view direction, and latent codes to color and density using sinusoidal positional encoding for inputs.
summary: Conditional NeRF with Sinusoidal Positional Encoding maps spatial position, view direction, and latent codes to volumetric density and color, distinguished by its explicit conditioning on latent vectors and use of sinusoidal positional encoding.
